page.overview:
Who is Traj Axxari?

Traj Axxari was approached by the Prisoner in Pinnacle Station. He explained to them that the slavers plaguing the hills surrounding the station were protected by Imperial sanction. He eleborated that Arrakis had three commodoties: Spice, water and manpower, the third of what House Harkonnen were severely lacking. He warned them that they would have a hard time avoiding slavers, as they were widespread in the area. He also stated that he only dealt with people who respected the deal and that Gloos Bohannon would shoot anyone who did not.
